verdict.rationale: Airweave exposes a documented public API confirmed via a live OpenAPI spec (airweave-probe-2), plus a CLI, MCP server, and SDK-like collection/source-connection concepts documented in depth (airweave-docs-1,2,3,4,6,14), giving AI-native users multiple documented programmatic paths to drive the product. Missing for 10: independent third-party confirmation of API stability/versioning or rate limits beyond vendor docs.
